_comment: Pinned mirror of compose-lint's curated capability profiles, consumed by the
v1 parity cross-check gate (PLAN.md 'v1 success criteria' > Correctness, issue #294).
This is the INDEPENDENT signal called out in PLAN.md 'Validation methodology' and
weighted equal to bisection: a hand-curated reference maintained in a SEPARATE repo,
cross-checked against csd's own bisected ground truth so the two artifacts cannot
silently drift apart. The gate (internal/parity) requires the set difference between
each ground_truth.json and the curated_caps below to EXACTLY equal accepted_delta;
any drift on either side fails CI until the delta and its rationale are reconciled.
Pinned-by-value, on purpose: compose-lint has not yet shipped its automated catalog
(compose-lint #360). Until it does, the curated set is the reference cap list from
publishes real derived profiles, re-point `source` at that artifact and refresh
curated_caps in the same commit that updates docs/known-deltas.md.

source.artifact: curated postgres security profile (ADR-017 docs/adr/017-security-profile-catalog.md; reference cap set mirrored in tests/fixtures/profiles/postgres.example.yml)

accepted_delta.rationale: docs/known-deltas.md — 'postgres:16 — bisected [DAC_OVERRIDE, SETGID, SETUID] vs. compose-lint curated [CHOWN, DAC_OVERRIDE, FOWNER, SETUID, SETGID]': CHOWN and FOWNER are first-boot-only and are no-ops on this image's pre-owned data dir, so they never fault the kernel cap check the workload exercises.
